## Use-Cases & User Stories for Unit U12_Alarms

**User:** System Administrator

**Primary Flow:**

* User sets thresholds for blower motor, blower power system, and battery temperature alarms.
* System continuously monitors temperature sensors.
* When any temperature exceeds the threshold, the corresponding alarm is triggered.
* User can view alarm status in the GUI.
* System automatically performs safety actions when blower power system or battery temperature exceeds threshold.

**Alternative Flow:**

* User disables temperature monitoring.
* No alarms are triggered.

**Exception Flow:**

* System fails to read temperature sensors.
* Error message is displayed in the GUI.

**Test Cases:**

| TC-003 | Trigger battery temperature alarm | [RW-SW-135] | Positive | Threshold set for battery temperature | {temperature: 45} | Monitor temperature sensor | Alarm triggered |
| TC-004 | Safety action for blower power system temperature | [RW-SW-137] | Positive | Threshold set for blower power system | {temperature: 70} | Monitor temperature sensor | Safety action initiated |
| TC-005 | Safety action for battery temperature | [RW-SW-138] | Positive | Threshold set for battery temperature | {temperature: 50} | Monitor temperature sensor | Safety action initiated |

| TC-009 | Error message for missing temperature sensor | [RW-SW-132] | Negative | N/A | N/A | Monitor missing sensor | Error message displayed |
